item.title: All Zelda: Ocarina of Time Dungeons, Ranked From Worst to Best
item.description: While every moment of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is memorable, it’s the Nintendo 64 game’s dungeons that really stick in your memory. Each one is a tightly constructed puzzle box built around the tools you collect inside, culminating in an often-excellent boss fight. The game’s terrific Switch 2 remake doesn’t mess with that strength; it only refines some of Zelda’s best dungeons in tasteful ways .

item.title: Tom Morello Joins Critical Role for New Bard-Themed Adventure
item.description: The founders of Critical Role have always taken pride in shaking up the way they play tabletop role-playing games. But next week, a new adventure will push the cast and crew further than ever: a "Battle of the Bards," with Matthew Mercer as Game Master.

item.title: Where are all the rings in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 3?
item.description: As the name of the series implies, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power is focused on how the Dark Lord Sauron (Charlie Vickers) forged the Rings of Power as part of a scheme to control all of Middle-earth. As of season 3, the three Elven Rings, Seven Rings for the Dwarf-lords, and the Nine Rings for Mortal Men have all been made, while Sauron is working endlessly to complete his project by building the One Ring to rule them all.

item.title: Dragon Quest Creator Says New Game Will Capture the Series' 'Unmistakable Feeling'
item.description: The Dragon Quest series has taken players on countless journeys over the past four decades. Next year, fans will be able to embark on a new Dragon Quest adventure using their smartphones with the launch of Dragon Quest RPG The Cursed Tree and The Chosen Isle .

item.title: Rings of Power Episode 4 Ending Explained: What Happens to Galadriel, Celeborn, and Arondir?
item.description: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 3 sees Middle-earth in the midst of full-on war as Sauron (Charlie Vickers) continues his conquest. Yet he still hasn’t figured out how to forge the one weapon he knows will solidify his title as the Dark Lord: the One Ring.

item.title: Magic's Best Unofficial Format Is So Big, Burger King Is Running a Tournament
item.description: If you think that the Universe Beyond crossover with beloved sci-fi franchise Star Trek is the biggest thing currently going on in the Magic: The Gathering world, think again. On Nov. 10, details emerged from Italy about a country-exclusive collaboration between Magic and fast-food chain Burger King. Fans and players worldwide are going wild online about the Burger King-themed sleeves and deck box, but there is more to this unexpected campaign.

item.title: VisionQuest’s Post-Credits Scene Official Confirms Another Avenger Returning in Doomsday
item.description: VisionQuest completed the story that began in 2020 with WandaVision , bringing things full circle by again using the framing of classic sitcoms as a way to tell a deep story about grief and family. The VisionQuest finale was released on Nov. 10, and viewers will want to keep watching through the credits, which include a pair of scenes with big implications for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe .

item.title: In One Scene, Prime Video Officially Rewrites Gandalf’s Mission in Lord of the Rings
item.description: By the end of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 2, Gandalf (Daniel Weyman) had chosen his name and wizard staff and found a mentor in the enigmatic Tom Bombadil (Rory Kinnear). Season 3 picks up five years later, and Gandalf has spent that time vexing the Dark Wizard (Ciarán Hinds) and his forces in Rhûn. Gandalf sees the Dark Wizard as a dangerous foe, but their relationship is more complicated. Here’s what you need to know about the two wizards, and how they fit into J.R.R. Tolkien’s complex cosmology.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Already the Second-Best-Selling Switch 2 Game
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is the fastest-selling Switch 2 game yet. On Wednesday, Nintendo announced that the remake of the 1998 classic sold more than 5.2 million copies worldwide in its first four days on sale — "the highest global sales for any Nintendo-published Nintendo Switch 2 game in its first four days."

item.title: One of Doctor Who's Best Episodes Just Got Removed, and Fans Aren't Happy
item.description: Following the publication of allegations of sexual misconduct against British actor David Walliams, the BBC has removed several episodes, comedy sketches, and films featuring him, including his appearance in the Doctor Who episode "The God Complex." Unsurprisingly, the move has left fans online seething.
